lookup.note: Name lookup first: if you only have a protocol or token name (e.g. Aave, Ethena, USDe, Moonwell, kUSD), call pacta_lookup_protocol (or GET https://api.pacta.wtf/v1/protocols/lookup?q=<name>) to resolve its verified record: canonical slug and page URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (eas_attested: Base-EAS-attested, documentation compared; rpc_observed: on-chain control plane pinned over JSON-RPC, documentationComparison not_assessed; briefs), and preflightArgs {chain, address} for pacta_check_preflight. 324 protocols + 18 briefs, answered in memory with no RPC; free in every pricing mode; an empty query lists the catalog. Catalog: https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/lookup.json.

x402.gatewaySettlementGuard: The gateway verifies every paid settlement on Base before releasing the product: eth_getTransactionReceipt must show status 0x1 and canonical USDC Transfer(payer -> payTo 0x4348DF1BEFAffcbA248B5118B1b782B1B2bdEd14) logs summing to at least the route price, and each credited transaction is owned by one PactaLedgerDO Durable Object (tx:<txHash>), so it is never credited twice (402 replay_settlement_tx). Otherwise the product is withheld: 402 unconfirmed_or_reverted_settlement_tx / insufficient_onchain_usdc_transfer, or 502 settlement_rpc_unavailable when no Base RPC answers.
